added.summary: A `<Text>` is one paragraph: its text runs, the `<Text>` spans nested in it and the `<Icon>` and `<Image>` in it are laid out as one text that wraps, aligns, clamps and ellipsizes together. A span draws in its own size, weight, slant, family, spacing, colour and decoration; an icon or image takes its own px size (an em square without one) as an inline box centred on the text's middle. A span with `onPress` is pressed on its glyphs, on every line it runs over, which makes a link; the probe gives it the box of its first line.

`select-text` makes a text selectable, read only: a drag selects, a second press in a row selects the word and a third the whole text, and Control or Command + C copies it to the clipboard (+ A selects it all). `selection:bg-*` colours the highlight.

fixed.summary: `<Text>Gold: {n} coins</Text>` no longer lays its three runs out as boxes stacked one per line: they are one line of text.
